small_guidance:
- Increase BLOCK_S to 2048 or 4096 and try num_warps=16 with num_stages=3 to better saturate memory bandwidth on the mean-reduce kernel.
- Consider using multiple programs per batch (2D grid over (N, tile)) and a second small reduction kernel, since one program per batch (only 128 programs) under-utilizes the SMs on a 4090.
large_guidance:
- The Conv3d dominates runtime (fast_p ~0.61 with reduction already custom). Replace nn.Conv3d with a custom Triton im2col-style GEMM kernel: one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), implicit im2col gather, channels_last layout for coalesced K-dim loads, autotuned BLOCK_M/N/K.
- Fold GroupNorm's affine and the final mean reduction into the conv epilogue where possible: compute per-group stats with a small follow-up kernel over the conv output, then fuse normalize + spatial mean into one pass so the (N,C,D,H,W) tensor is read only twice instead of three times.
- At eval, fuse the conv bias add and group-norm scale/shift into the conv epilogue directly; produce per-(N,C) partial sums during the conv write so the final mean is a tiny (N,C) -> (N,) reduce.
